description:
Save a Hiro API key to ~/.aibtc/config.json for authenticated Hiro API requests.
Authenticated requests get higher rate limits than public (unauthenticated) requests.
Get a free API key at https://platform.hiro.so/

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

apiKey.description: Your Hiro API key - WARNING: sensitive value
